items.stem: A learner asks what distinguishes Git from GitHub. Which statement is accurate?

options.text: Git is a distributed version-control system; GitHub is a hosting and collaboration platform built around Git
options.rationale: Correct: Git is the version-control tool, while GitHub hosts Git repositories and adds collaboration features.

options.text: Git and GitHub are the same product with different names
options.rationale: They are distinct: one is the tool, the other is a hosting platform.

options.text: GitHub is a version-control system and Git is a website
options.rationale: This reverses the roles; Git is the version-control system.
Git is independent of GitHub and works with many hosts or none.

items.explanation: Correct: Git is the version-control tool, while GitHub hosts Git repositories and adds collaboration features.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which file conventionally tells contributors how to report vulnerabilities in a GitHub repository?

options.rationale: Correct: SECURITY.md documents the repository's security policy and how to report vulnerabilities.
README introduces the project but is not the security-policy file.
CODEOWNERS assigns review ownership of paths, not vulnerability reporting.
LICENSE states usage rights, not security reporting.

items.explanation: Correct: SECURITY.md documents the repository's security policy and how to report vulnerabilities.

items.stem: Select TWO GitHub features used to collaborate on and track work within a repository. (Select TWO.)

options.rationale: Correct: issues track bugs, tasks and discussions of work.
Correct: pull requests propose and review changes for collaboration.
A billing tier is an account setting, not a collaboration-and-tracking feature.
A commit SHA identifies a commit; it is not itself a collaboration feature.
.gitignore controls which files Git tracks; it is not a work-tracking feature.

items.explanation: Correct: issues track bugs, tasks and discussions of work.
